name: mff-erp-tg-bot
description: Enterprise-grade headless CMS — Hono + Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2

scripts.dev:clean: pkill -f wrangler 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f vite 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f workerd 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f 'turbo run' 2>/dev/null || true; for port in 5174 5175 8787 8788 8789 9230 9232; do pid=$(lsof -tiTCP:$port -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$pid" ]; then echo "→ killing port $port (pid $pid)"; kill $pid 2>/dev/null; fi; done; sleep 1; lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':(5174|5175|8787|8788|8789|9230|9232)' || echo 'All dev ports clear'
scripts.cli:link: cd packages/cli && node build.js && pnpm link --global
scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:api && pnpm run deploy:studio
scripts.check: pnpm check:infra && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check
